proposal.hypothesis: Cases with substantial secondary-axis bias (case_0041: x-conf 0.235, case_0031: x-conf 0.346) fail under dominant-only repair because uncorrected secondary drift accumulates throughout the recovery rollout; lowering secondary_axis_threshold and raising dominance_ratio to favour simultaneous_xy_repair will increase recovery_success for these mixed-bias cases without degrading single-dominant cases (case_0017: x-conf 0.931) where the secondary component is negligible.
proposal.expected_metric_change: recovery_success increases for case_0041 and case_0031 under config 1 (secondary_axis_threshold=0.02, dominance_ratio=3.0) by >=0.1 vs config 2; case_0017 recovery_success remains unchanged across both configs within ±0.05

proposal.hypothesis: Cases where secondary-axis confidence exceeds 0.2 (case_0041 at 0.235, case_0031 at 0.346) fail under dominant_axis_repair because the uncorrected secondary drift (~0.12 in x for case_0041, ~0.09 in x for case_0031) accumulates over the recovery rollout; routing these ambiguous cases to simultaneous_xy_repair via dominance_ratio≥3.0 or secondary_axis_threshold≤0.04 will achieve 6/6 recovery.
proposal.expected_metric_change: recovery_success increases from 5/6 to 6/6; mean_recovery_environment_steps decreases for previously-failed case due to corrected secondary drift preventing wasted steps
